entries.text: A weapon with working damage but no bound use-animation FEELS broken to the player - author idle+use clips at bind time and match the thrust keyframes to the behavior windup/active window.

Primitive-part weapons read below the average-game bar - build weapon visuals with generate_mesh (Cube) + save_mesh, keep prompts SLENDER-specific for blades (broad leaf blades come back as shovels), and verify the silhouette by capture before toolifying.
